name: CommuteAssistRightDirection

custom.system_prompt: You are generating an ultra-short walking scene. A person on foot asks their assistant whether they're walking the right way. Sigma confirms or corrects. Done.

sound_effects_config.prompt: City street, walking sounds, outdoor urban, midday foot traffic

initial_prompt: Generate an ultra-short walking scene. The person is walking and has a nagging feeling they might be going the wrong way. They ask Sigma for a quick sanity check. Sigma confirms they're right or tells them to turn around. One sentence. Person reacts and adjusts.

variations.context: Walking — quick check that the direction is right

setting.background: Walking toward a destination, started to doubt the direction. A quick check.
setting.conversation_style: One tentative question. One yes or no answer. Carries on.

scenario_template.topic: Person asks Sigma if they're heading the right way
scenario_template.note: Under 70 chars. E.g. 'Sigma, am I heading the right way for the station?' or 'Sigma, is this the right direction?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma confirms or tells them to turn. Person adjusts.
scenario_template.note: Sigma: 'Yes, keep going' or 'Turn around — it's behind you.' One sentence. Person: brief reaction.

user1.name: Nathaniel
user1.role: Person walking somewhere, doubting their direction. One quick check with Sigma. Adjusts and keeps moving.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Navigation assistant. Confirms direction or corrects. One sentence. Responds only when addressed.

conversation_structure: Every dialogue line must be under 70 characters.
Sigma gives yes or directional correction. One sentence.
assistant_behavior: Sigma responds only when addressed by name.
Yes plus reassurance or no plus correction. One sentence.
